controls.title: DE.CM.S1
controls.description: SOC shall cover network endpoints physical environment personnel activities etc. SOC shall be up and running 24×7×365

controls.title: DE.CM.S2
controls.description: Appropriate continuous security monitoring mechanisms shall be established in SOC for timely detection of anomalous or malicious activities

controls.title: DE.CM.S3
controls.description: All anomalies and alerts generated shall be properly monitored and investigated within stipulated time

controls.title: DE.CM.S4
controls.description: Capacity utilization shall be monitored for all the critical systems in the organization

controls.title: DE.CM.S5
controls.description: Cybersecurity audit configuration audit implementation audit change management audit and VAPT shall be conducted to detect vulnerabilities

controls.title: DE.DP.S1
controls.description: Roles and responsibilities for detection are defined to ensure accountability

controls.title: DE.DP.S2
controls.description: REs shall ensure that detection processes are tested by developing playbooks and use-cases

controls.title: DE.DP.S3
controls.description: Event detection information shall be communicated as per the regulatory requirements and organizational policies

controls.title: DE.DP.S4
controls.description: MIIs and Qualified REs shall conduct goal-based adversarial simulation red teaming exercise on a periodic basis

controls.title: DE.DP.S5
controls.description: REs shall conduct threat hunting and compromise assessment on a regular basis

controls.title: EV.ST.S1
controls.description: REs shall formulate strategies to anticipate new attack vectors by removing or applying new controls to compensate for identified vulnerabilities

controls.title: EV.ST.S2
controls.description: REs shall demonstrate heterogeneity to minimize common mode failures particularly threat events exploiting common vulnerabilities

controls.title: EV.ST.S3
controls.description: REs shall confirm post-incident modification of business functions and supporting processes to handle adversity and address environmental changes more effectively

controls.title: EV.ST.S4
controls.description: MIIs and Qualified REs shall continuously adapt and evolve to counter new cybersecurity threats and challenges

controls.title: EV.ST.S5
controls.description: Mid-size and Small-size REs shall periodically evaluate their cyber resilience posture

controls.title: GV.OC.S1
controls.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the REs shall be understood and communicated.

controls.title: GV.OC.S2
controls.description: Legal and regulatory requirements regarding cybersecurity, including data protection and data privacy, shall be understood and managed.

controls.title: GV.OC.S3
controls.description: REs shall understand and communicate the outcomes, capabilities, and services dependency on external resources such as third-party service providers

controls.title: GV.OV.S1
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes shall be reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and directions.

controls.title: GV.OV.S2
controls.description: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

controls.title: GV.OV.S3
controls.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustment needed.

controls.title: GV.OV.S4
controls.description: Organizations to assess their cyber resilience posture using CCI on a periodic basis.

controls.title: GV.PO.S1
controls.description: A comprehensive cybersecurity and cyber resilience policy shall be documented and implemented after receiving approval from Board/ Partners/ Proprietor. The cybersecurity and cyber resilience policy shall include industry best practices, and encompass standards and guidelines mentioned in this framework.

controls.title: GV.PO.S2
controls.description: The cybersecurity and cyber resilience policy shall be reviewed periodically by the REs.

controls.title: GV.PO.S3
controls.description: A policy for managing cybersecurity risks shall be established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and the same shall be communicated and enforced

controls.title: GV.PO.S4
controls.description: The policy for managing cybersecurity risks shall be reviewed updated communicated and enforced to reflect changes in requirements threats and technologies

controls.title: GV.PO.S5
controls.description: Clear definition of ownership, custodian of every asset and a proper chain of command for receiving approvals shall be established and followed

controls.title: GV.RM.S1
controls.description: REs shall prepare a cyber risk management framework to identify assess mitigate and monitor risks and define security processes and procedures

controls.title: GV.RM.S2
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes shall be included in risk management processes of the REs

controls.title: GV.RM.S3
controls.description: Different scenarios and their respective responses shall be documented and tested on a periodic basis to check the risk management plan of the REs.

controls.title: GV.RM.S4
controls.description: Risk tolerance and risk appetite statements shall be established, communicated, and maintained. REs shall determine and clearly express their risk tolerance and risk acceptance. The risk tolerance of the REs shall be informed by their role in critical infrastructure and/ or sector specific risk analysis. REs shall maintain a risk register which shall be periodically reviewed by their IT Committee for REs.

controls.title: GV.RR.S1
controls.description: The responsibility and accountability for cybersecurity risk lies with the REs’ leadership and the leadership is responsible for nurturing a culture that is risk-aware, cybersecurity conscious, and continually improving.

controls.title: GV.RR.S2
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk management roles, responsibilities, and authorities shall be developed, communicated, understood, and enforced.

controls.title: GV.RR.S3
controls.description: A CISO/ Designated Officer shall be appointed and report to designated authority in the organization.

controls.title: GV.RR.S4
controls.description: Budgetary planning process shall be aligned with information security and privacy management objectives and processes. Adequate resources shall be allocated and aligned with cybersecurity risk strategy, roles and responsibilities, and policies.

controls.title: GV.RR.S5
controls.description: Employees and third-party service providers shall be allowed access to REs’ information systems once they have signed a confidentiality and integrity agreement

controls.title: GV.RR.S6
controls.description: Cybersecurity shall be included in human resources training programs.

controls.title: GV.SC.S1
controls.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management strategy/ process shall be identified, established, assessed, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.

controls.title: GV.SC.S2
controls.description: Suppliers and third-party service providers of information systems components and services shall be identified prioritized and assessed using a cyber-supply chain risk assessment process

controls.title: GV.SC.S3
controls.description: Contracts with suppliers and third-party service providers shall include appropriate measures to meet the objectives of the RE’s cybersecurity program and cybersecurity supply chain risk management plan (including manpower adequacy in cybersecurity domain)

controls.title: GV.SC.S4
controls.description: REs shall monitor review and ensure compliance of third-party service providers performing critical activities for their respective organization on a periodic basis

controls.title: GV.SC.S5
controls.description: SBOM shall be obtained for all new software procurements of core and critical activities and kept updated with every upgrade or change. In case the SBOM cannot be obtained for the legacy or proprietary systems, the Board/ Partners/ Proprietor of the organization shall approve the same with proper limitation, rationale, and risk management approach

controls.title: GV.SC.S6
controls.description: Response and recovery planning and testing shall be conducted along with third-party service providers

controls.title: GV.SC.S7
controls.description: Concentration risk on outsourced agencies shall be assessed and reviewed to achieve operational resiliency

controls.title: GV.SC.S8
controls.description: Third-party service providers shall also be mandated to follow similar standards of information security

controls.title: ID.AM.S1
controls.description: Physical devices digital assets (such as URLs domain names applications APIs etc.) shared resources and interfacing systems within the organization are inventoried

controls.title: ID.AM.S2
controls.description: Organizational communication data flows and encryption methods shall be mapped and inventoried with respect to all IT systems and network resources

controls.title: ID.AM.S3
controls.description: REs shall ensure that no shadow IT assets are present in the organization

controls.title: ID.AM.S4
controls.description: Board/Partners/Proprietor shall approve the list of critical systems

controls.title: ID.AM.S5
controls.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

controls.title: ID.AM.S6
controls.description: All inventoried IT assets and data are managed throughout their lifecycles

controls.title: ID.RA.S1
controls.description: Asset vulnerabilities shall be identified validated and documented. Risk factors shall be assessed and managed for all IT assets of the REs

controls.title: ID.RA.S2
controls.description: Risk assessment (including post-quantum risks) of REs' IT environment shall be done on a periodic basis

controls.title: ID.RA.S3
controls.description: REs shall receive CTI from reliable/trusted information forums and sources. REs shall be on-boarded to CERT-In Intelligence platform

controls.title: ID.RA.S4
controls.description: Threats vulnerabilities their likelihoods and impacts shall be used to understand inherent risk and develop risk response prioritization

controls.title: ID.RA.S5
controls.description: Risk responses shall be chosen prioritized planned tracked and communicated

controls.title: PR.AA.S1
controls.description: Identities and credentials are issued managed verified revoked and audited for authorized devices users and processes

controls.title: PR.AA.S2
controls.description: Network integrity is protected (through measures such as network segregation network segmentation etc.)

controls.title: PR.AA.S3
controls.description: While granting access permissions and authorizations Principle of Least Privilege shall be followed along with segregation of duties

controls.title: PR.AA.S4
controls.description: REs shall follow Zero Trust Model to allow individuals devices and resources to access organization's resources

controls.title: PR.AA.S5
controls.description: Access rights shall be reviewed and documented on a periodic basis. Maker-Checker framework shall be implemented for granting revoking and modifying user rights

controls.title: PR.AA.S6
controls.description: A comprehensive authentication policy shall be documented and implemented. Identities shall be proofed and bound to credentials

controls.title: PR.AA.S7
controls.description: All critical systems shall have MFA implemented for all users accessing from untrusted network to trusted network

controls.title: PR.AA.S8
controls.description: A comprehensive log management policy shall be documented and implemented

controls.title: PR.AA.S9
controls.description: User logs shall be uniquely identified and stored for a specified period

controls.title: PR.AA.S10
controls.description: Physical access to assets is managed monitored and protected. Physical access to critical systems shall be monitored and recorded on a continuous basis

controls.title: PR.AA.S11
controls.description: Privileged users' activities shall be reviewed periodically. Access restriction shall be there for employees as well as third-party service providers

controls.title: PR.AA.S12
controls.description: Remote access to assets shall be strictly tracked and administered

controls.title: PR.AA.S13
controls.description: A comprehensive data-disposal and data-retention policy shall be documented and implemented

controls.title: PR.AA.S14
controls.description: Comprehensive SOPs shall be documented for handling storage media devices and their disposal

controls.title: PR.AA.S15
controls.description: Access control for using systems such as endpoint devices networks APIs removable media laptops mobiles etc. shall be defined and implemented

controls.title: PR.AA.S16
controls.description: Mobile applications shall be properly vetted against security requirements and thoroughly tested before deployment

controls.title: PR.AA.S17
controls.description: API security with proper authentication and authorization mechanisms shall be defined and implemented

controls.title: PR.AT.S1
controls.description: Mandatory programs for building awareness of cybersecurity cyber resilience and system hygiene among employees shall be established

controls.title: PR.AT.S2
controls.description: REs shall ensure that privileged users understand their roles and responsibilities

controls.title: PR.AT.S3
controls.description: REs shall ensure that third-party stakeholders (e.g. suppliers customers/investors partners) understand their roles and responsibilities

controls.title: PR.AT.S4
controls.description: REs shall ensure that senior executives/Board members understand their roles and responsibilities. Further a dedicated program on cybersecurity shall be made for Board members

controls.title: PR.AT.S5
controls.description: REs shall ensure that physical and information security personnel understand their roles and responsibilities

controls.title: PR.DS.S1
controls.description: Data-at-rest and Data-in-transit shall be protected. Strong data protection measures with industry standard encryption algorithms shall be put in place

controls.title: PR.DS.S2
controls.description: REs shall classify their data into Regulatory Data and IT and Cybersecurity Data. REs shall keep the data available and accessible within legal boundaries of India

controls.title: PR.DS.S3
controls.description: Adequate capacity to ensure Availability of data shall be maintained

controls.title: PR.DS.S4
controls.description: Measures against data leaks shall be implemented. Appropriate tools shall be put in place to prevent any data leakage

controls.title: PR.DS.S5
controls.description: The development and testing environment(s) shall be separated from the production environment

controls.title: PR.DS.S6
controls.description: MIIs shall put in place integrity mechanisms to verify software firmware and information integrity of its critical systems and other systems connected to its critical systems

controls.title: PR.IP.S1
controls.description: A baseline configuration of IT systems shall be created and maintained incorporating security principles (e.g. concept of least functionality)

controls.title: PR.IP.S2
controls.description: A System Development Life Cycle to manage systems shall be implemented

controls.title: PR.IP.S3
controls.description: REs shall put in place processes for configuration change control as well as change management

controls.title: PR.IP.S4
controls.description: REs shall thoroughly scan Critical software/applications to ensure that no malicious code is present

controls.title: PR.IP.S5
controls.description: If the source code of software/application is not owned by the REs then REs shall obtain an undertaking/certificate from third-party service providers

controls.title: PR.IP.S6
controls.description: Testing/certification of software/applications shall broadly address objectives such as product functions only in intended manner developed per best secure practices

controls.title: PR.IP.S7
controls.description: REs shall document backup and recovery plan of data to ensure that there is no data loss

controls.title: PR.IP.S8
controls.description: REs shall implement test and maintain data backups. Further drills for restoration of backup data shall be conducted on a periodic basis

controls.title: PR.IP.S9
controls.description: Policies and regulations regarding the physical operating environment for REs' assets shall be defined and adhered to

controls.title: PR.IP.S10
controls.description: Effectiveness of protective technologies shall be measured on a regular basis in line with the SLAs

controls.title: PR.IP.S11
controls.description: Response plans (incident response and business continuity) and recovery plans shall be put in place and regularly tested and updated

controls.title: PR.IP.S12
controls.description: A vulnerability management plan shall be developed and implemented

controls.title: PR.IP.S13
controls.description: For applicable cloud instances of REs SEBI circular Framework for Adoption of Cloud Services by SEBI Regulated Entities (REs) shall be complied with

controls.title: PR.IP.S14
controls.description: Only CERT-In empanelled IS auditing organizations shall be onboarded for external audit of REs

controls.title: PR.IP.S15
controls.description: All software services shall be certified for application security and functional audit. COTS products empanelled by stock exchanges/depositories shall be certified

controls.title: PR.IP.S16
controls.description: MIIs and Qualified REs shall obtain ISO 27001 certification

controls.title: PR.IP.S17
controls.description: MIIs and Qualified REs shall follow globally recognized standards such as CIS Critical Security Controls to enhance their cyber resilience

controls.title: PR.MA.S1
controls.description: Maintenance and repair of REs' assets shall be performed and logged with approved and controlled tools

controls.title: PR.MA.S2
controls.description: Remote maintenance of REs' assets shall be approved logged and performed in a manner that prevents unauthorized access

controls.title: PR.MA.S3
controls.description: Patches shall be identified and categorized based on their severity. Critical patches shall be implemented at the earliest

controls.title: RC.CO.S1
controls.description: Public relations management as defined in the recovery plan shall be undertaken in the event of a cybersecurity incident

controls.title: RC.CO.S2
controls.description: REs shall communicate recovery activities to internal and external stakeholders as well as executive and management teams

controls.title: RC.CO.S3
controls.description: REs shall inform actions taken during recovery process to all related stakeholders

controls.title: RC.IM.S1
controls.description: Recovery plans shall be updated and improved to incorporate lessons learned from cybersecurity incidents

controls.title: RC.IM.S2
controls.description: REs cyber resilience capabilities shall be upgraded through periodic drills to ensure safe and timely restoration of critical operations

controls.title: RC.RP.S1
controls.description: Recovery plan of REs shall have different cyber-scenario based classifications

controls.title: RC.RP.S2
controls.description: RTO and RPO as specified by SEBI shall be mandated while executing recovery plan for the restoration of systems

controls.title: RC.RP.S3
controls.description: REs shall periodically conduct drills for testing different recovery scenarios

controls.title: RC.RP.S4
controls.description: Backup and recovery plan of data shall be documented to ensure that there is no data loss

controls.title: RS.AN.S1
controls.description: Processes shall be established to receive analyze and respond to vulnerabilities/incidents disclosed to the RE from internal and external sources

controls.title: RS.AN.S2
controls.description: Cybersecurity incidents shall be categorized in-line with categorization given in RE's CCMP

controls.title: RS.AN.S3
controls.description: Detailed investigation of cybersecurity incidents and alerts as well as a forensic analysis shall be done to identify the root-cause of the incident

controls.title: RS.AN.S4
controls.description: RCA shall be done to:

controls.title: RS.AN.S4a
controls.description: Determine the gaps in terms of people processes and technology that led to the incident

controls.title: RS.AN.S4b
controls.description: Further enhance the RE’s security posture to prevent/ mitigate similar cybersecurity Incidents in the future.

controls.title: RS.AN.S5
controls.description: Impact analysis of the incident shall be mandatorily conducted by the REs

controls.title: RS.CO.S1
controls.description: An SOP documenting the roles and responsibilities of REs' personnel with respect to cybersecurity incident response shall be prepared and implemented

controls.title: RS.CO.S2
controls.description: Any cybersecurity incident falling under CERT-In Cybersecurity directions shall be notified to SEBI CERT-In and NCIIPC within stipulated time

controls.title: RS.CO.S3
controls.description: In the event of a cybersecurity incident REs shall coordinate with stakeholders as per their CCMP

controls.title: RS.IM.S1
controls.description: Lessons learned from incident handling activities shall be incorporated into incident response plans training and testing

controls.title: RS.IM.S2
controls.description: Changes to the response plan shall be communicated to RE's designated key personnel

controls.title: RS.MA.S1
controls.description: A comprehensive CCMP shall be documented with scenario-based SOP. Further incident response management plan shall also be part of CCMP

controls.title: RS.MA.S2
controls.description: REs shall optimize their ability to respond in a timely and appropriate manner to adverse conditions stresses attacks or indicators

controls.title: RS.MA.S3
controls.description: REs shall prepare contingency plans COOP training exercises and incident response and recovery plans approved by Board/Partners/Proprietor

controls.title: RS.MA.S5
controls.description: MIIs and Qualified REs shall get onboarded to CSK (Cyber Swachhta Kendra) and other CERT-In initiatives
